About Swiggy & Swiggy Instamart

Swiggy is an Indian multinational on-demand delivery platform headquartered in Bengaluru, Karnataka. Founded in 2014, the company expanded beyond food delivery to launch Swiggy Instamart, its rapid quick-commerce grocery delivery service. Swiggy’s marketing and communication team is widely recognized for creative, trend-driven campaigns that define modern consumer engagement in India. Joining Swiggy Instamart offers early-career professionals direct exposure to fast-paced corporate marketing, agency coordination, and brand storytelling.

Key Highlights of Swiggy Social Media Trainee Hiring 2027

Roles and Responsibilities of Swiggy Hiring 2027

Selected candidates will work directly with the core social media team of Swiggy Instamart. Key tasks include:

Social Handle Calendar Management: Collaborate with agency partners to align and maintain structured content calendars.

Creative Brief Oversight: Monitor creative briefs, track execution timelines, and ensure high-quality delivery across channels.

Amplification & Campaigns: Lead social amplification projects for high-priority marketing campaigns with external agencies.

Influencer Marketing: Draft clear influencer briefs, shortlist talent, and coordinate project execution from start to finish.

Trendspotting & Copywriting: Identify viral online trends early, edit copy, write engaging briefs, and craft compelling influencer captions.

Eligibility Criteria & Key Skills

Educational Qualification & Experience

Education: Graduation in any stream from a recognized university or institute.

Experience: 0 to 1 year of relevant experience in digital marketing, social media management, or content editing.

Availability Requirement: Candidates must commit to a minimum availability of 6 months.

Preferred Skills

Social Media Marketing: Deep understanding of Instagram, X (Twitter), YouTube, and short-form video engagement.

Written Communication: Excellent command of written English to draft creative, non-generic captions and briefs.

Influencer Coordination: Basic understanding of influencer briefs and campaign tracking.

Project Management: Ability to manage multiple agency deliverables and track project timelines under fast-paced timelines.

Stipend, Salary & Career Benefits

Salary Package: ₹4.00 to ₹5.00 LPA CTC.

Hands-on Experience: Work directly with top creative agencies and influencer networks on high-visibility campaigns.

Portfolio Building: Build a strong portfolio managing quick-commerce brand handles seen by millions of consumers.
